quarterly_data.signal: Fluor 10-Q: in the first half of 2026 Fluor sold NuScale Power shares and completed the sale of CFHI (COOEC-Fluor Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.).

Fluor 10-Q legal proceedings: in February 2026 alleged NuScale Power shareholders filed a complaint in the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon against NuScale, two NuScale executives and Fluor; an amended complaint in July 2026 added two current Fluor employees who are former NuScale directors. The plaintiffs purport to represent shareholders who acquired NuScale securities between March 3, 2025 and November 6, 2025 and seek damages for alleged securities-law violations based on statements about NuScale's relationship with ENTRA1 Energy LLC, alleging Fluor failed to prevent or correct them and benefited from insider trading. Fluor intends to contest these claims.

Fluor 10-Q: first-half 2026 capital expenditures were $18 million (H1 2025: $25 million), primarily construction equipment on infrastructure projects and IT; cash and cash equivalents were $2,923 million at June 30, 2026.
